english.title: Fail to ensure wild / semi-wild equines slaughtered within 7 days of date shown on sticker
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[owner having primary day-to-day responsibility for a wild or semi-wild equine, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUINE..), that was aged 12 months or over and being moved from a designated area to a place for slaughter,]_
(B)_[keeper of a wild or semi-wild equine, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUINE..), that was aged 12 months or over and being moved from a designated area to a place for slaughter and for which the owner did not have primary day-to-day responsibility,]_

failed to ensure that the equine was slaughtered within 7 days of **(..SPECIFY DATE ON STICKER..), the date shown on the sticker attached in accordance with regulation 22(2) of the Equine Identification (England) Regulations 2018
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 22(3), 24 and 36 of the Equine Identification (England) Regulations 2018.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
owner/keeper of wild/semi-wild equine
aged 12 months or over
moved equine from designated area to a place for slaughter
whether or not for purposes of human consumption
failed to ensure that in addition to the requirement of an ID document
equine is slaughtered within 7 days of date shown on sticker

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 37(1) provides that an enforcing authority may impose a civil sanction, or a combination of civil sanctions, under Part 6 against a person if the authority is satisfied beyond reasonable doubt that the person is guilty of this offence.
(ii) Regulation 37(2) provides that criminal proceedings may not be started or continued against a person if any enforcing authority, in respect of the offence, chooses to apply civil sanctions and services a compliance notice, non-compliance penalty notice or fixed monetary penalty notice on that person.

SUMMARY: A fine
